name: InsertPolyAndLineIntersection
formula: =LAMBDA(vertices,xp,yp,xq,yq,IF(COLUMNS(vertices)<2,INDEX(vertices,1,2),LET(n, ROWS(vertices), intersections, SEQUENCE(n), column3, EXPAND(FALSE, n, 1, FALSE), column4, CHOOSECOLS(vertices, 1) & "," & CHOOSECOLS(vertices, 2), verticesArr, IF(ISERROR(INDEX(vertices, 1, 3)), HSTACK(vertices, column3, column4), vertices), results, REDUCE(0, intersections, LAMBDA(a,i, LET(xi, INDEX(verticesArr, i, 1), yi, INDEX(verticesArr, i, 2), xj, INDEX(verticesArr, IF(i = n, 1, i + 1), 1), yj, INDEX(verticesArr, IF(i = n, 1, i + 1), 2), cRow, CHOOSEROWS(verticesArr, i), intersectionPt, {ref}TwoLinesIntersection(xi, yi, xj, yj, xp, yp, xq, yq), x, INDEX(intersectionPt, 1, 1), y, INDEX(intersectionPt, 1, 2), intersection, HSTACK(intersectionPt, TRUE(), x & "," & y), IF(ISNA(INDEX(intersection, 1, 1)), VSTACK(a, cRow), IFS(AND(xi = INDEX(intersection, 1, 1), yi = INDEX(intersection, 1, 2)), VSTACK(a, intersection), AND(xj = INDEX(intersection, 1, 1), yj = INDEX(intersection, 1, 2)), VSTACK(a, cRow), TRUE, VSTACK(a, cRow, intersection)))))), DROP(results, 1))))
comment: Inserts intersections of a closed polygon and a line segment into the vertex list. vertices is an n×2 array of (x, y) rows in order, or an n×4 array that already has an intersection flag and a name. The last vertex connects to the first. The segment is (xp, yp) to (xq, yq). Each result row is x, y, TRUE at an intersection or FALSE at an original vertex, and the name x & "," & y. A hit on the first vertex of an edge replaces that vertex. A hit on the last vertex is left for the next edge. A segment that misses returns the vertices with FALSE flags. Fewer than two columns returns #REF!. A non-numeric coordinate returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
